curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: use words with the sounds (/s/, /l/, /i /, /p/) in sentences

interactions.prompt: Tap the word that begins with /s/.
interactions.retryHint: Say each word slowly and listen to its first sound.

interactions.feedback: Perfect! Pia, packs and pot carry /p/.
interactions.retryHint: Listen for the little puff at the start of p words.

interactions.prompt: Sort each word by its first sound.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, then its sound.
interactions.feedback: Great listening! Every word reached its sound home.
interactions.retryHint: Stretch the first sound of each word.

interactions.prompt: Complete the sentence: At lunch, Lina lifts the ___.
interactions.feedback: Correct! 'Lina lifts the lid' is meaningful and practises /l/.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the word that makes sense and begins with /l/.

interactions.prompt: Which sentence correctly tells what happens at a Kenyan shop?
interactions.feedback: Wonderful sentence! Lina, sits, in and shop practise /l/, /s/, /i/ and /p/ sounds.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the meaningful sentence with words in a sensible order.

interactions.prompt: Choose the sentence containing words with all four target sounds /s/, /l/, /i/ and /p/.
interactions.feedback: Sound star! Lina, sits, in and park practise the target sounds.
interactions.retryHint: Find l, s, i and p words.
